reviews.title: Great overall GPU
reviews.comment: I use it as eGPU. It didn't work with one old minipc with PCIe 3.0 only (probably because of this minipc motherboard or BIOS, and I didn't want to replace BIOS), but then I replaced to the Beelink SER8 minipc and it worked over USB4 with adapter+R43SG PCIe 4. It was basically plug+play after installing the AMD adapters. It works well with 1440p gaming (the 16GB are really important here) considering the bandwidth with USB4 is only 40Gb/s. Didn't notice any problem till now. Overall, the RX 6800 has great value/cost. Will try in the future to connect directly via OCuLink adapter.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Solid card but the coil whine is pretty bad.
reviews.comment: Great GPU, took a while for me to get it due to some local storms but it’s a pretty good upgrade from my RTX 3060 12GB. AMD’s Adrenaline software is decent, it allowed me to undervolt with easy as well as set a good fan curve without the need for 3rd party software. The per-game settings are also pretty solid, still getting used to AMD after being a long time Nvidia user but I think I’ll be happy with it in the long run. Took 1 star off for the coil whine, it should (HOPEFULLY) get better over time but it’s pretty bad in some heavier games like BF6. So be weary if that’s something that might really bother you, it will never go away but it *might* get better over time once it’s broken in. I understand that it’s a thing that can happen on any card from any maker but this coil whine is the worst I’ve encountered in many years of building my own PCs.
reviews.author: Mike C.

reviews.title: XFX RX 6800
reviews.comment: Yeah I'm not quite sure what the "1 Stars" are about but it prompted me to post a review to offset them. This card works great. I used it in a third PC built for a friend. It runs very cool compared to it's siblings, sips power compared to other offerings and happily sits at 2215Mhz while gaming and has a 16gb buffer. Easily one of the best deals in gaming right now.
